preserve: All 14 slides and existing content except overview placeholder. Keep all media and titles. Use current slides as own exemplars, populate in place; add matching body text to empty slides 7, 9, 10.

copy.text:
Say what you want, in everyday language
"Brighter, focus on the panda, photo in five seconds."

Watch the camera adjust and take the photo
Use Smart Mode when you are unsure what to ask.

Open the photo and describe an edit
Keep the original and compare your edited versions.

Choose photos, draft a caption, and share
Review the caption, then choose where to send it.

Speech + scene + camera context
The request includes a reduced frame and lens capabilities.

AI turns the request into an ordered plan
Brightness, zoom, white balance, focus, timer, capture.

Android checks and executes each action
CameraX / Camera2 apply only supported changes.

Recovery stays on the phone
Reject stale plans, roll back failures, or use Reset.

Edit with a photo and a written or spoken request
Qwen Image creates a new version, preserving the original.

Generate a caption from the selected photos
A contact sheet gives the model context for the draft.

Refine the result before sharing
Change the caption length, type edits, or give feedback.

Hand off to Android sharing
The user chooses the destination and sends the photos.

HY3 + Mobile Application Developer
Traced the Android journey and found issues in the code.

Kimi-K3 + UI Designer
Reviewed clarity, accessibility, and recovery.

HY3 + Software Workshop
Implemented selected fixes and verified them on OnePlus.

Changes users can see
Clearer Stop guidance and Reset for reversible adjustments.
